edit.ability:
(OFS) Gain 13 Creation Counters.
(OFS) or (OYT) if none exist, summon a Spawn of the Forbidden One onto any friendly creature, giving it all this creature's creation counters.
(1CD) Give a Spawn of the Forbidden One 2 creation counters.
When the Spawn of the Forbidden One dies, gain Creation Counters equal to half the amount used on it.
